summary: Columbus McKinnon Corporation filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 reporting a First Amendment to its February 3, 2026 Credit Agreement. The amendment refinances the outstanding Term Loan B into $1,452.9 million of Tranche B Term Loans and cuts the applicable margin by 0.50% per annum on both the term loan and the revolving facility. Term SOFR margin on the Term Loan B is now 3.00%; revolver margins range 1.75%–2.75% based on Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio. J.P. Morgan SE was added as administrative agent for the German Borrower. This is a routine credit-facility repricing, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
